Outdoors by a yellow stucco wall, the blonde man with a mullet in a black velvet suit (R2) on the left and the dark-haired man in a navy suit (R1) on the right are slow dancing. The blonde man (R2) holds the dark-haired man's (R1) waist, and their other hands are clasped. They look lovingly at each other under soft, warm natural daylight.
